exact_tokens: Make execution_role part of the canonical attempt packet in Contracts_V0.md and storage-plan.md
Define operational_identity as a separate optional field family for receipts, artifacts, and side-effect-bearing attempt/tool records
execution_role and operational_identity solve different problems and should not be merged
notes: execution_role answers what kind of actor/execution responsibility this was; operational_identity answers what external side-effect identity/target context was in play. These must remain separate fields.
